description: Write the outbound list of a PAID hosted app or bot: either policy open, which allows everything out, or policy allowlist with the rules of what it may reach. The whole list is replaced by what is passed, so read get_app_firewall first and send the rules that should remain. A rule is a protocol (tcp or udp), one port like 443 or a range like 50000-65535, and optionally one IPv4 destination range to narrow it to. Refuses a free app: its list is the plan fixed list and cannot be changed. Refuses a destination in a private or internal range, because an app cannot reach those with or without a rule. Refuses a port that is closed for every app, named or inside a range. Refuses an allowlist with no rules; use policy open for that. Refuses while the app is paused. Needs full access to the app. A running app is restarted to pick the list up; a stopped one picks it up on its next start.

app.description: The app id (bot_...) from list_bots. Must be on a paid tier.

policy.description: open allows everything out. allowlist allows only the rules, and then rules is required.

rules.description: The complete list, replacing whatever is saved. Required with policy allowlist, ignored with policy open.

destination.description: An optional public IPv4 range to narrow the rule to, like 203.0.113.0/24, or one address like 203.0.113.7. Leave it out for anywhere.

ports.description: One port, like 443, or a range low-high, like 50000-65535. From 1 to 65535.

name: set_app_firewall

message.description: What was saved and when it takes hold.

restarted.description: Whether the app was restarted to pick the list up.

rule_count.description: How many rules are now saved.

title: Set app firewall
